theorem amc12b_2002_p4 (n : ℕ) (h₀ : 0 < n)
  (h₁ : ((1:ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) + 1 / (3 : ℚ) + 1 / (7 : ℚ) + 1 / (↑n : ℚ)).isInt) :
  ¬ 2 ∣ n ∨ ¬ 3 ∣ n ∨ ¬ 6 ∣ n ∨ ¬ 7 ∣ n ∨ ¬ 84 < n := by
  suffices h : n ≤ 84 by right; right; right; right; omega
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hn : (85 : ℤ) ≤ ↑n := by omega
  have hpos : (0:ℚ) < (↑n : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast h₀
  have hle : (1:ℚ) / (↑n : ℚ) ≤ 1 / 85 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff hpos (by norm_num : (0:ℚ) < 85)]
    have : (85 : ℚ) ≤ ↑n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    linarith
  have key : (1:ℚ) / 2 + 1 / 3 + 1 / 7 + 1 / ↑n < 1 := by
    linarith [show (1:ℚ)/2 + 1/3 + 1/7 = 41/42 from by norm_num,
              show (1:ℚ)/85 < 1/42 from by norm_num]
  have hpos2 : (0:ℚ) < 1 / 2 + 1 / 3 + 1 / 7 + 1 / ↑n := by positivity
  set q := (1:ℚ) / 2 + 1 / 3 + 1 / 7 + 1 / ↑n with hq_def
  have hq_int : q.isInt = true := h₁
  have hq_den : q.den = 1 := by
    unfold Rat.isInt at hq_int
    exact Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true hq_int
  have hq_cast : (q.num : ℚ) = q := by
    have := q.num_div_den
    rw [hq_den] at this
    simp at this
    linarith
  have h_num_pos : (0 : ℤ) < q.num := by
    have : (0 : ℚ) < q.num := by rw [hq_cast]; exact hpos2
    exact_mod_cast this
  have h_num_lt : q.num < 1 := by
    have : (q.num : ℚ) < 1 := by rw [hq_cast]; exact key
    exact_mod_cast this
  omega

theorem amc12a_2020_p4 (S : Finset ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S ↔ 1000 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 9999 ∧ (∀ d : ℕ, d ∈ Nat.digits 10 n → Even d) ∧ 5 ∣ n) :
  S.card = 80 ∨ S.card = 100 ∨ S.card = 125 ∨ S.card = 200 ∨ S.card = 500 := by
  suffices S.card = 100 by right; left; exact this
  have hST : S = (Finset.Icc 1000 9999).filter (fun n => (∀ d ∈ Nat.digits 10 n, Even d) ∧ 5 ∣ n) := by
    ext n
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have := (h₀ n).mp h
      exact ⟨⟨this.1, this.2.1⟩, this.2.2⟩
    · intro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
      exact (h₀ n).mpr ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  rw [hST]
  native_decide
